item.title: Chez Safran Landing Systems, Véronique Marcel transmet sa passion des procédés spéciaux
item.dc:creator: Valentin Hamon-Beugin
item.description: En 2027, Véronique Marcel fêtera ses 40 ans de carrière au sein de Safran Landing Systems (anciennement Messier-Bugatti-Dowty), leader mondial des systèmes d’atterrissage et de freinage pour aéronefs. Une fidélité hors du commun, d’autant que cette ingénieure reconnaît ne pas être particulièrement férue d’aéro.

item.title: SSA-069220 V1.1 (Last Update: 2026-08-13): Stack Overflow Vulnerability in Simcenter Nastran Before V2606
item.dc:creator: Siemens ProductCERT
item.description: <p>Simcenter Nastran is affected by a stack overflow vulnerability that could be triggered when an application binary reads arbitrary string as a file argument. If a user is tricked to run one of the impacted application binary with a malicious string, an attacker could leverage the vulnerability to perform remote code execution in the context of the current process.</p> <p>Siemens has released new versions for the affected products and recommends to update to the latest versions.</p>

item.title: SSA-834709 V1.0: Missing Authentication Vulnerability in Node-RED on SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced with Industrial OS
item.dc:creator: Siemens ProductCERT
item.description: <p>SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced devices running Industrial OS with Node-RED installed contain a missing authentication vulnerability in the Node-RED HTTP interface that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create malicious flows and execute arbitrary code on the underlying server with maximum privileges.</p> <p>Siemens has released a new version for SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced and strongly recommends to update to the latest version.</p>

item.title: SSA-751328 V1.0: Recoverable Hardcoded AES Master Key in Siemens LOGO! Soft Comfort
item.dc:creator: Siemens ProductCERT
item.description: <p>Siemens LOGO! Soft Comfort contains multiple vulnerabilities in its project-file encryption and password handling mechanisms. A local attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities to extract the master key, allowing them to decrypt project data or remove project passwords. The lack of password salting enables offline dictionary or brute-force attacks against the password hashes. Successful exploitation could result in unauthorized access to, or modification of, sensitive project logic and configurations.</p> <p>Siemens has released a new version for LOGO! Soft Comfort and recommends to update to the latest version.</p>
